blog.title: Solving 300+ LeetCode Problems: Key Backend Insights
blog.excerpt: Lessons learned from solving 300+ algorithmic challenges and how data structures directly inform backend system design.
blog.content:
Solving over 300 algorithm problems on LeetCode transformed the way I think about software performance and memory management in production systems.

In backend engineering with Python and Django, understanding time and space complexity isn't just academic — it's the difference between a query taking 5 seconds or 50 milliseconds. Optimized data structures directly improve database index usage, caching strategy, and API response times.

blog.title: Building Scalable REST APIs with Django & FastAPI
blog.excerpt: Comparing Django REST Framework and FastAPI for microservices, asynchronous execution, and database ORMs.
blog.content:
When constructing backend systems, choosing between Django REST Framework and FastAPI depends on project requirements, ORM needs, and async concurrency.

While DRF provides rapid scaffolding and powerful built-in ORM tools, FastAPI excels at high-concurrency async endpoints. In multi-tenant systems, combining robust PostgreSQL schema design with Redis caching yields resilient backend architectures.

blog.title: Mentoring Next-Gen Backend Developers
blog.excerpt: What teaching at Codial IT Academy taught me about clean code, documentation, and engineering leadership.
blog.content:
Teaching backend development at Codial IT Academy reinforced a fundamental principle: if you can't explain a software architecture concept simply, you don't understand it deeply enough.

Helping aspiring engineers master Django, REST APIs, and database migrations improved my own code review standards and communication skills as a developer.
